row:
Our mission is to offer high quality education, create the opportunity for our students to experience their full potential and to develop the skills necessary in becoming successful massage therapists. Our method of instruction stresses self awareness and personal growth resulting in higher comprehension and effectiveness as a professional practitioner. We view this field as a service to humanity, and therefore assist students in creating an awareness for linking this training into their personal and professional goals. A sense of community is emphasized to help support students and alumni. We specialize in the delivery of a curriculum that is expansive and on the cutting edge of the massage industry.

The Colorado School of Healing Arts (CSHA) is a school specializing in quality training programs that are based in student centered education.
